newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-PHILIPPOUSSIS AND LARSSON TO CLASH IN TOULOUSE FINAL.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-PHILIPPOUSSIS AND LARSSON TO CLASH IN TOULOUSE FINAL.

text.p: Rising Australian Mark Philippoussis and veteran Swede Magnus Larsson meet for the first time in Sunday's final of the Toulouse Grand Prix.
Philippoussis, the fourth seed, needed three sets and two tie-breaks to overcome compatriot Mark Woodforde 2-6 7-6 7-6 in a semifinal clash on Saturday.
Former top 10 player Larsson beat the top seed, Chilean Marcelo Rios, 6-4 6-4-in the other semifinal.
Larsson, out of action for five months last year because of a foot fracture, said: "I think this is my best week since I came back after my injury.
"Physically, I feel fine. Even If I had to play five sets in the final, I think I could manage."
